text:
Alex Morgan: Hey team — first day setup question. My new M2 arrived and I ran through initial setup but Kandji shows 'MDM enrollment pending admin approval' and the login screen says 'Enrollment blocked: awaiting e-sign'. I never got a DocuSign email. Who handles that?

Sofia Chen: @alex.morgan — welcome! HR e-sign is required for the device agreement. I can resend. Quick Q: are you on Redwood-Staff Wi‑Fi or home network? Cert/profile push only happens once we can reach the device.

Alex Morgan: I’m on home Wi‑Fi right now. Is there a VPN route to trigger the cert push? I tried the Redwood VPN but Zscaler device trust never finishes.

Sofia Chen: You can trigger enrollment over VPN but sometimes Zscaler/Okta device trust blocks the handshake if the device isn't trusted yet. Steps I’ll do: (1) resend DocuSign; (2) if you sign, reboot and connect to Redwood-Staff (or use home + VPN with Always-on off). If Zscaler times out paste output of `sudo /usr/local/bin/zscalerctl status` (if you have sudo). If not, I can provision temp-admin.

Taylor Ramos: If you need Docker/colima this week, ask for a short temp-admin window (4hr). Otherwise use remote dev container in Codespaces until we sort MDM.

Alex Morgan: I don’t have sudo. I ran `fdesetup status` and it says 'FileVault is On' so encryption looks fine. The DocuSign link I found earlier expired.

IT Bot: Ticket #RD-2026-1987 created for device enrollment. Assigned to Sofia Chen.

Sofia Chen: Resent DocuSign to alex.morgan@redwood.com — new link valid 48h. Also provisioned a 3-hour temp sudo token (Kandji action id ka-873). You should see a one-time Kandji prompt.

Alex Morgan: Got the email and signed. Rebooted, connected to home Wi‑Fi, launched VPN with "Always-on off". Kandji now says 'install failed: certificate not trusted'. Screenshot available in ticket.

Sofia Chen: Looks like the CA cert didn't get pushed. Try installing manually: 
```
curl -o /tmp/redwood-ca.crt https://pki.redwood.internal/ca/root.crt
sudo security add-trusted-cert -d -r trustRoot -k /Library/Keychains/System.keychain /tmp/redwood-ca.crt
```
If that errors with permission denied, tell me and I'll remote in.

Alex Morgan: Ran those commands, got 'added certificate'. Kandji now reports 'profile installed' but Zscaler still shows pending device trust.

Taylor Ramos: If Zscaler is stuck, try clearing the process and reauth: `sudo pkill -f zscaler` then reopen the app and sign in. Check `/Applications/Zscaler/Logs/` for recent logs if it still fails.

Alex Morgan: `pkill` did the trick — Zscaler finished device trust and Kandji shows enrolled. FDE still On. Thanks :tada:

Sofia Chen: Awesome — noted in the ticket that temp-sudo was used and set to auto-revoke. If you get any kext prompts for virtualization or networking, ping me and we can pre-approve the profile.

Alex Morgan: Quick follow up — I need Rosetta for a few tools. Can I run `softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license` with the temp sudo?

Sofia Chen: Yep, go for it. Temp sudo will expire automatically after the window. If you need additional packages we can push them via Kandji policy instead of keeping sudo.

Taylor Ramos: FYI you can install Homebrew for arm at `/opt/homebrew` without sudo, but some formulas still touch system paths. If anything asks for elevated perms, shout and we’ll do a short join session.

Alex Morgan: Rosetta installed and Docker + colima are up. `sw_vers` shows 13.4.1. Any guidance on OS updates?

Sofia Chen: Keep security patches current. We run CI on 13.5.1 but you’re fine to start. If you want to upgrade to match CI, I can schedule a maintenance window. Welcome aboard and congrats!
